about: Terms that GLOSSARY.md defines and no tracked file uses yet, each with the reason and the ticket that will bring it into use. The glossary files test fails on an unused term not listed here, on a listed term that a tracked file now uses, and on a listed term that GLOSSARY.md no longer defines: remove an entry in the change that first uses its term. Recording is the default taken on 19 November 2026 while MAG-136 holds the open choice between recording these terms and moving them to a design note.
